headers.//: Hash-named immutable assets — the content hash IS the cache buster, so cache forever. Without this, Vercel's default 'max-age=0, must-revalidate' forces 8+ round-trips per page load (one per chunk) which dominated initial-load perceived latency (2026-05-24 incident — Manoj reported 'loading real slow' after deploy; full vendor-charts/vendor-i18n/vendor-react chunks were being conditionally re-fetched on every hard reload).
Non-hashed root assets — favicon, manifest, icons — get a short cache. They CAN change without filename change, so we can't go immutable. 1 hour is the standard balance.
